Return & Refund Policy | ORYVIA Care
ORYVIA Care · Customer Policy

Return & Refund Policy

We want you to receive the ORYVIA Care products you ordered in the expected condition. This policy explains how to contact us if an order arrives damaged, incorrect, defective, or otherwise has a problem.

Effective Date: 21 October 2026  ·  Website: oryviacare.in

Please note: Skincare and personal-care products may be subject to hygiene and safety restrictions. Return eligibility depends on the reason for the request, the product's condition, the published terms, and applicable consumer law. Nothing in this policy limits a remedy that you are legally entitled to.

1. When Can I Request a Return or Refund?

You may contact us to request a return, replacement, or refund if your order is affected by an issue such as:

  • The product arrived damaged or leaked during delivery.
  • You received a product different from the one you ordered.
  • The product appears defective or was expired when delivered.
  • The product is materially different from its description or has another issue for which a remedy is available under applicable law.

We will assess each request based on the facts, the information provided, the product type, and applicable law. Where appropriate, we may offer a replacement, refund, or another suitable resolution.

2. Time to Report an Issue

Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery if an order arrives damaged, incorrect, leaking, or visibly defective. This helps us investigate the issue promptly.

If you discover a problem later, or if a product is defective or otherwise eligible for a remedy under applicable law, please contact us as soon as reasonably possible. The reporting window above is a request for prompt notification and does not remove any non-excludable legal rights.

3. Conditions for Returns

Where a return is appropriate and permitted, please keep the product and its packaging in a safe condition until we respond.

  • Keep the product, outer packaging, and any included accessories where possible.
  • Do not discard the item before our support team has reviewed your request.
  • Share clear photographs or a short video if needed to show damage, leakage, incorrect items, or the relevant label and expiry details.
  • Keep your order number or purchase confirmation available.

For hygiene and safety reasons, opened, used, or unsealed skincare and personal-care products may not be eligible for change-of-mind returns, except where a return, replacement, refund, or other remedy is required by law or is expressly offered by us.

4. Items That May Not Qualify for a Change-of-Mind Return

Subject to applicable law and the remedies available for defective, damaged, incorrect, expired, or misdescribed products, the following may not be accepted for a change-of-mind return:

  • Products that have been opened, used, or unsealed.
  • Products damaged after delivery due to misuse, improper storage, or handling unrelated to a product defect.
  • Orders where the customer has changed their mind, if the item is not covered by a voluntary return offer.

This section does not exclude legal remedies for product defects, safety issues, incorrect fulfilment, misleading descriptions, or other circumstances covered by applicable law.

5. How to Request a Return or Refund

  1. Contact us using the customer support details below, preferably from the email address or phone number associated with your order.
  2. Provide your order number, the product name, and a short description of the issue.
  3. Attach clear photographs or video where relevant, such as images of the damaged package, product, shipping label, or expiry information.
  4. Wait for our team to review your request and provide return or resolution instructions. Please do not send an item to an address that has not been confirmed by our team.

We may request reasonable additional information needed to verify the order and assess the reported issue.

6. Refund Approval and Processing

If a refund is approved, it will generally be issued to the original payment method where possible, or through another appropriate method agreed with you and permitted by law.

  • Prepaid orders: The refund will be initiated through the relevant payment provider or payment method, where supported.
  • Cash on Delivery orders: We may request suitable bank or digital payment details to process an approved refund. We will not ask for your card PIN, UPI PIN, OTP, or account password.
  • Processing time: The time taken for the amount to appear in your account may depend on the payment provider or bank. We will share the refund status where reasonably possible.

Any applicable refund will be processed within the time required by law and the terms communicated when the refund is approved. If a refund is delayed, please contact us with your order number.

7. Return Shipping Costs

If the return is due to an incorrect item, damage in transit, a verified product defect, or another issue attributable to us, we will explain the return or collection arrangement and handle reasonable return costs as required by our policy and applicable law.

For any voluntary change-of-mind return that we expressly permit, responsibility for return shipping costs will be communicated before the return is arranged.

8. Order Cancellations

You may request cancellation before dispatch by contacting us or using any cancellation option available on the website. Whether cancellation can be completed depends on the order's processing status.

Once an order has been dispatched, cancellation through the normal order process may no longer be possible. Please contact our team for guidance. If we cancel an order after payment has been collected, we will arrange any applicable refund in accordance with applicable law.

9. Damaged, Incorrect, or Missing Deliveries

If a parcel arrives visibly damaged, please take photographs of the outer packaging and product, if it is safe and practical to do so. If an item is missing or incorrect, contact us with your order details and a description of what you received.

We may coordinate with our delivery partner to investigate. We will assess the available information and communicate an appropriate resolution under this policy and applicable law.

10. Exchanges and Replacements

Exchanges or replacements may be offered when a product is damaged, incorrect, defective, or otherwise eligible for a remedy. Availability depends on stock and the nature of the issue.

If the same product is unavailable, we will discuss an appropriate alternative or refund where applicable. We will not substitute a materially different product without your agreement where such agreement is required.

11. Promotional Offers and Bundles

If an order includes a discount, bundle, or promotional offer, the refund amount will be calculated in accordance with the offer terms shown at purchase and applicable law.

Where only part of a bundle is returned, we may need to recalculate the promotion if its disclosed terms require all bundle items to be retained to qualify. We will explain the calculation before completing the refund. This provision does not restrict any mandatory consumer remedy.

12. Contact and Customer Grievances

For return, refund, replacement, cancellation, or delivery concerns, contact our team using the details below.

13. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Return & Refund Policy to reflect changes in our operations, products, delivery arrangements, or applicable law. The revised version will be published on this page with an updated effective date. Changes will not remove rights that have already accrued or any consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

ORYVIA Care · Privacy & Trust

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how ORYVIA Care collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you browse our skincare store, create an account, place an order, or contact us.

Effective date: 21 October 2026Website: oryviacare.in
Your privacy matters. We use personal information to operate our online store, fulfil orders, provide customer support, maintain security, and carry out other purposes explained below. Where consent is required by applicable law, we will obtain it before the relevant processing.

At ORYVIA Care (“ORYVIA”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.

This Privacy Policy applies when you visit oryviacare.in, browse our products, create an account, place an order, contact us, or otherwise interact with our website and services.

Our store offers skincare and personal care products, including face wash, facial scrub, D-Tan products, herbal facial kits, anti-dandruff shampoo, anti-hairfall shampoo, and other products that may be introduced from time to time.

01Who We Are

This website is operated under the ORYVIA Care brand. The business contact details for privacy questions and requests are set out below. Please complete the marked business details before publishing this page.

BrandORYVIA Care
Websitehttps://oryviacare.in/
Legal business nameORYVIACARE
Privacy / support emailoryviacare@gmail.com
Business addressChak Swar,Rampur, UP, 244924
Contact number+91 9105430713

02Information We Collect

We collect information reasonably necessary to operate our website, process orders, provide customer service, and improve the shopping experience. The information we collect depends on how you interact with us.

A. Personal and contact information

When you create an account, place an order, or contact us, we may collect:

  • Your name, email address, and mobile phone number.
  • Billing and shipping or delivery addresses.
  • Account details and login-related information.
  • Order history, purchased products, and customer service enquiries.
  • Information you choose to provide in forms, emails, reviews, or support messages.

B. Order and transaction information

We may collect order numbers, items and quantities purchased, order totals, discounts, payment status, delivery status, and details required to manage cancellations, returns, refunds, or disputes.

C. Payment information

Payments may be handled by third-party payment service providers. We may receive transaction references, payment status, payment method details, and other information needed to confirm or manage a payment.

We do not intend to store complete payment card numbers, card security codes, or payment account passwords on our own servers. The information collected and retained may depend on the payment method and provider used.

D. Technical and website usage information

Depending on our website configuration, we or our service providers may automatically collect information such as IP address, browser type, device and operating system details, pages visited, referring pages, visit times, and diagnostic or interaction information.

03How We Use Your Information

We may use information for the following purposes:

  • To receive, confirm, process, and fulfil orders.
  • To arrange packaging, shipping, delivery updates, and order tracking.
  • To manage payments, cancellations, returns, refunds, and exchanges.
  • To create and maintain customer accounts.
  • To answer questions, handle complaints, and provide customer support.
  • To send important service messages about orders, delivery, security, or changes to our policies.
  • To maintain website operations, troubleshoot errors, and improve usability and performance.
  • To protect our website, customers, and business from fraud, misuse, and unauthorised access.
  • To maintain business records and comply with legal requirements.
  • To send marketing communications where permitted by law and where required, with your consent.

We will not use personal information for a materially unrelated purpose without providing information or obtaining consent where required by applicable law.

04Consent and Permitted Processing

We process personal information for purposes disclosed to you and permitted by applicable law. Depending on the context, this may include fulfilling your purchase, responding to your request, meeting legal obligations, protecting our website and business, or carrying out processing for which valid consent has been provided.

Where consent is required, we will seek it before the relevant processing. You may withdraw consent through the available contact channels or other method we provide. Withdrawal does not affect processing lawfully carried out before the withdrawal.

If you withdraw consent for information necessary to provide a requested service, we may be unable to continue providing that service. We will explain the practical effect where reasonably possible.

05How We Share Information

We do not sell your personal information to third parties for their own independent marketing purposes. We may share relevant information with service providers or other parties when reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy.

  • Payment providers: to process payments, verify transactions, and handle refunds.
  • Shipping and logistics partners: to deliver orders and provide tracking updates.
  • Website hosting and technical providers: to host, maintain, secure, and operate the website.
  • Analytics and website tools: to understand usage, measure performance, and diagnose issues where these tools are enabled.
  • Communication and support providers: to deliver service messages and respond to customer enquiries.
  • Professional advisers and public authorities: where reasonably necessary for legal compliance, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, or a lawful request.

Where third parties process information on our behalf, we aim to share only what is reasonably necessary for their role and to use appropriate contractual, confidentiality, and security measures as required by law.

06Cookies and Similar Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support essential functions and improve your browsing experience. Depending on the tools enabled, these technologies may be used to:

  • Keep products in your shopping cart.
  • Maintain login sessions and remember preferences.
  • Support checkout, security, and fraud prevention.
  • Measure website traffic and performance where analytics are enabled.
  • Support advertising or marketing measurement where applicable.

You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the shopping cart, account access, checkout, or other website features. Where required by law, we will obtain consent before using non-essential cookies or similar tracking technologies.

07Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy or as required by applicable law.

  • Order and transaction records may be kept for fulfilment, accounting, refunds, disputes, fraud prevention, and legal requirements.
  • Account information may be retained while an account remains active and for an appropriate period afterwards where needed.
  • Customer support communications may be retained to resolve enquiries and maintain service records.
  • Marketing information is managed according to customer preferences, consent requirements, and applicable law.

When information is no longer needed, we will take reasonable steps to delete it or permanently anonymise it, subject to lawful retention requirements and legitimate recordkeeping needs.

08Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, loss, misuse, or destruction. Depending on our website configuration, measures may include secure connections, access controls, software updates, monitoring, and protections provided by our hosting or service providers.

No website or electronic transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We cannot promise absolute security, but we will take appropriate steps to address security risks and comply with applicable legal obligations.

If a personal data breach occurs, we will take appropriate steps to investigate and mitigate its effects and provide notifications where required by applicable law.

09Your Privacy Rights

Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

  • Request information about the personal data we process about you.
  • Request correction or completion of inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Request erasure of personal information where applicable, subject to lawful retention requirements.
  • Withdraw consent for processing that relies on your consent.
  • Raise a complaint or grievance about our handling of your personal information.
  • Exercise other rights made available to you under applicable data protection law.

To exercise a right, contact us using the details in the Contact and Grievance section. We may ask for reasonable information to verify your identity before acting on a request. We will respond within the period required by applicable law.

You may also have the right to nominate another person to exercise specified rights on your behalf where this is provided by applicable law.

10Marketing Communications

We may send promotional emails, messages, product announcements, or offers where permitted by law and where the necessary consent or other lawful basis exists.

You can opt out of marketing communications by using the unsubscribe option in the message, where available, or by contacting us directly. Opting out of marketing will not necessarily stop essential messages about an existing order, payment, delivery, account security, or legal obligation.

11Third-Party Websites and Services

Our website may link to or use third-party services, including payment gateways, delivery tracking, analytics, social media, and communication platforms.

We do not control independent third-party websites or their privacy practices. Your use of those sites and services is subject to their applicable terms and policies. We encourage you to review them before providing information directly to a third party.

12Children's Privacy

Our website and products are intended for a general consumer audience. We do not knowingly collect children's personal data in circumstances where collection is prohibited or requires consent or verification that we have not obtained.

Where applicable law requires verifiable parental consent or additional safeguards for processing children's personal data, we will comply with the relevant requirements.

If you believe a child has provided personal information to us inappropriately, please contact us so we can review the matter and take appropriate action.

13Account Closure and Data Deletion Requests

If you have an ORYVIA Care account and wish to close it or request deletion of your personal information, contact us using the details below.

We will review your request and delete or anonymise information where appropriate and legally permissible. Certain records may need to be retained to fulfil pending orders, process refunds, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, or meet legal and accounting requirements.

Deleting an account does not automatically cancel an order already being processed. Please contact customer support separately if you need assistance with an existing order.

14Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our business operations, website functionality, service providers, products, or applicable law.

We will publish the revised Policy on this page and update the effective date. Where required by law, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent for material changes before applying them to the relevant processing activities.

We encourage you to review this page periodically.

15Contact Us and Privacy Grievances

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, wish to exercise your privacy rights, or have a complaint about the handling of your personal information, contact us using the details below.

Contact number+91 9105430713

Please include your name, order number if relevant, a clear description of your concern, and a preferred way to contact you. Do not send passwords, card security codes, OTPs, or other sensitive payment credentials.

We will review genuine requests and complaints in accordance with applicable law.

Skincare and personal care for your everyday routine.
